# Best way to keep Instagram for group chats but drop Reels (college students, 2026) (en)

Short answer: use Instagram inside an app that opens it in its own browser with Reels hidden and DMs working (minulo, UNDOOMED or Stillfeed). If you keep opening the official app out of habit, lock it with Screen Time. Safari extensions work if you are fine using Instagram in Safari. Screen Time on its own blocks your group chats along with Reels.

This page is written by the developer of minulo. Facts about other apps come from their US App Store pages and, where noted, their websites, checked 2026-10-27. Features and prices can change.

Approach | Apps | Group chats | Reels | Tradeoffs
- In-app browser | minulo, UNDOOMED, Stillfeed | Keep working inside the app | Hidden inside the app | Instagram's website has no voice messages or calls, and posting Stories is not available. The official app still opens unless you lock it
- Screen broadcast | Slowth | You stay in the official app | It watches the screen and, when Reels appear, Screen Time blocks the whole app | You start a screen recording yourself. A block covers the whole app, chats included
- Screen broadcast, Reels only | Scroll Less | Keep working in the official app (per its App Store page) | Blocked inside the official Instagram app while its Blocker is on | You start a broadcast yourself. Instagram and YouTube apps only; English only
- Safari extension | Nope, ScrollGuard | Keep working on instagram.com in Safari | Hidden in Safari | You use Instagram in Safari instead of the app; the official app is unchanged. ScrollGuard needs iOS 18. Nope is free and covers Instagram and YouTube
- Screen Time alone | Built into iPhone | Blocked together with Reels | Blocked with the whole app | Free and nothing to install, but there is no setting that blocks only Reels

## Why this page is about students

In minulo's first-month data, 87% of the 577 users who answered the age question are 24 or younger, and Instagram is the first network about 70% of users open (minulo, October 2026). The most common reason is the one in the title: the class, club and dorm group chats are on Instagram, and Reels come with them.

## In-app browser apps compared

- minulo: 10 networks (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X, Threads, Facebook, Pinterest, Reddit, LinkedIn, Snapchat). DMs only on Instagram and TikTok is free (Every tab but DMs). Can lock the official apps with Screen Time; the block screen has an Open in minulo button. iPhone and Mac, no Android. Launched September 2026, 2 US ratings (2026-11-10). Built by one developer in Japan.
- UNDOOMED: 7 networks (Instagram, Threads, Reddit, Facebook, X, YouTube, LinkedIn); TikTok and Snapchat are listed as unavailable. Messages Only mode for Instagram and LinkedIn is Pro, per its website. iPhone and Android. 108 US ratings, average 4.3, on the App Store since October 2025.
- Stillfeed: 8 networks (Instagram, YouTube, X, Reddit, Snapchat, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok). Hiding Reels, Explore and Shorts is free, and since version 1.2.6 (November 9) it can lock the official apps with Screen Time for free; DMs Only is Pro ($2.99/week, $5.99/month or $44.99 to $99.99/year). 1 US rating, on the App Store since July 2026 (checked 2026-11-10).

## Scroll Less: Reels blocked inside the official app

Scroll Less works differently from the in-app browser apps above. Its App Store page says it blocks Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts inside the official Instagram and YouTube apps, while DMs, story replies and search keep working. Its website says the Blocker finds Reels and Shorts on your iPhone after you start an iOS broadcast for it. TikTok is not mentioned. English only. 25 US ratings, average 4.5, on the App Store since March 2025. We have not tested it ourselves.

## Which one fits you

- You only need the group chats. Use a messages-only view: minulo's Every tab but DMs (free), UNDOOMED's Messages Only (Pro) or Stillfeed's DMs Only (Pro).
- You want friends' posts too, just no Reels. minulo, UNDOOMED and Stillfeed all do this for free.
- You have an Android phone, or switch between iPhone and Android. UNDOOMED is the one of these with an Android app.
- You keep opening the official app on autopilot. Lock it with Screen Time. minulo turns the block screen into a shortcut to its Reels-free Instagram (Open in minulo), so the chats are still one tap away.
- You need voice messages, calls or posting Stories. Those need the official app. Slowth keeps you in it but blocks the whole app when Reels appear. Scroll Less's App Store page says it blocks only Reels inside the official app (we have not tested it).
- You do not want another app. Use instagram.com in Safari with Nope (free) or ScrollGuard, or use Screen Time and accept that the chats are blocked too.

## Group chat notifications

With minulo, notifications come from the official Instagram app. If you leave the official app unlocked, they arrive as usual and you can reply in minulo. While the official app is locked with Screen Time, its notifications do not arrive, so lock it only when you can miss them, for example while studying. Since version 1.0.19, Pro users can turn on DM notifications (beta) so Instagram DM notifications still arrive while Instagram is blocked, except during Sleep mode, Work mode or after the daily limit.

## What is the best way to keep Instagram for group chats but drop Reels?
Open Instagram inside an app that hides Reels and keeps DMs, such as minulo, UNDOOMED or Stillfeed. For messages only, minulo's Every tab but DMs is free; UNDOOMED and Stillfeed offer a messages-only mode in Pro. If you keep going back to the official app, lock it with Screen Time.

## Can I remove Reels from the official Instagram app?
Most apps that hide Reels show Instagram in their own browser or in Safari, or, like Slowth, watch the screen and block the whole app when Reels appear. Scroll Less is an exception: its App Store page says it blocks Reels inside the official Instagram app while its Blocker is on, and its website says it detects them on your iPhone through an iOS broadcast. We have not tested it. minulo doesn't change the official app: it can lock it with Screen Time and send you to its Reels-free Instagram instead.

## Why not just use Screen Time?
Screen Time blocks the whole Instagram app, so your group chats are blocked together with Reels, and it has no setting that blocks only Reels. It works well combined with an app that keeps the chats available elsewhere.

## Is there a free option?
Yes. Hiding Reels while keeping DMs is free in minulo, UNDOOMED and Stillfeed, and minulo's messages-only setting is free too. Nope, a Safari extension for instagram.com and youtube.com, says it is fully free.

## Does it work for YouTube Shorts and TikTok too?
minulo hides YouTube Shorts and TikTok's For You feed, and keeps YouTube search, subscriptions and TikTok messages. UNDOOMED and Stillfeed cover YouTube; UNDOOMED lists TikTok as unavailable, while Stillfeed now covers TikTok and sends For You and LIVE to Following.
Source: https://minulo.app/en/reels-blocker-for-college-students.html


## Is minulo safe? (en, checked 2026-10-23)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/is-minulo-safe.html

Q: Is minulo safe?
A: minulo has no account and never receives your social media ID or password: you sign in on each network's own website inside the app, and the connection does not go through a minulo server. It sends only anonymous usage data and error reports to PostHog, tied to a random ID rather than to you. Your records stay on your iPhone, and deleting the app erases them.

Q: Is minulo legit?
A: Yes. minulo is on the App Store (seller: ayumu kitabayashi) and is made by ReliefNote, a sole proprietorship in Hokkaido, Japan, founded in July 2025 by Ayumu Kitabayashi. Hiding Reels and Shorts is free. It is a new app (September 2026), so it has few ratings so far.

Q: Can minulo see my Instagram password?
A: No. You type your password on Instagram's own sign-in page shown inside minulo, and it is sent straight to Instagram. minulo does not receive, store or send your ID or password. Login cookies are kept in the storage iOS gives minulo, which other apps and the developer can't read.

Q: Does minulo collect my data or track me?
A: It collects anonymous usage data (actions like starting a block, which network you turned back from, language and region settings, iOS version), error reports with URLs and names removed, and whether you came from an App Store search ad. It does not collect your name, email, location or advertising identifier, and it does not track you across other companies' apps or websites. Its App Store label lists only Data Not Linked to You.

Q: Can minulo see which apps I block with Screen Time?
A: No. Apple gives apps opaque tokens for the apps you pick, to protect your privacy. minulo stores those tokens on your iPhone and passes them back to Screen Time, but it can't tell which apps they stand for.


## Stopping doomscrolling at night on iPhone (en, checked 2026-10-23)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/stop-doomscrolling-at-night.html

Q: How do I stop doomscrolling at night on iPhone?
A: Schedule Downtime in Settings > Screen Time (Screen Time Schedule on iOS 27), set a Screen Time passcode and turn on Block at Downtime so it can't be ignored. Add a sleep schedule in the Health app so Sleep Focus starts during wind down, and charge your phone away from the bed. If you want to keep DMs, hide only Reels and Shorts with an app like minulo instead of blocking the whole app.

Q: Does Sleep Focus block Instagram or TikTok?
A: No. Sleep Focus filters notifications and calls and can switch to a different Home Screen page, but it doesn't stop apps from opening. To stop apps, use Screen Time Downtime with Block at Downtime, or lock them with an app such as minulo.

Q: How do I make Downtime so I can't ignore it?
A: Set a Screen Time passcode and turn on Block at Downtime in Settings > Screen Time > Downtime. Blocked apps then appear dimmed with an hourglass and can't be opened. Also check Always Allowed, since apps listed there stay open.

Q: Can I block Instagram at night but still get DMs?
A: Not with Screen Time alone, because it blocks the whole app, DMs included. With minulo you can open Instagram with Reels hidden, or with only DMs left, and lock the official app at night. While the official app is locked, its notifications don't arrive. Since version 1.0.19, Pro users can turn on DM notifications (beta) so Instagram DM notifications still arrive while Instagram is blocked, except during Sleep mode, Work mode or after the daily limit.

Q: Is there a free way to stop scrolling before bed?
A: Yes. Downtime, Sleep Focus, Grayscale, YouTube's Shorts feed limit and Instagram's Sleep mode are all free. In minulo, hiding Reels and Shorts is free, and locking the official apps is free for up to 2 hours per block; locking them every night from bedtime to wake time is Sleep mode, part of Pro.



## Hiding the Instagram Explore page (en, checked 2026-10-23)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/hide-instagram-explore.html

Q: Can you remove the Explore page on Instagram?
A: Not with a setting. As of October 2026 we could not find one in Instagram's help. You can change what Explore shows, but the tab stays. To hide it, open Instagram in an app that hides Explore, such as minulo, where this is free and DMs keep working.

Q: How do I clean up my Instagram Explore page?
A: In Explore, touch and hold a post you don't want and tap Not interested. You can also set Sensitive content to Less under Content preferences, or use Reset suggested content to start your recommendations over. A reset cannot be undone.

Q: Does resetting suggested content clear Explore?
A: It clears your recommendations across Explore, Reels and Feed at the same time, so Explore starts fresh. The tab itself stays, and Instagram's help says suggestions become personalized again as you like, share and interact with content.

Q: Can Screen Time block only Explore on Instagram?
A: No. Screen Time limits or blocks the whole Instagram app. It has no option for one tab inside the app, and blocking Instagram this way blocks your DMs too.

Q: How do I hide Explore but keep my DMs?
A: Use an app that opens Instagram with Explore hidden. In minulo, turn on Explore tab in the Instagram settings (since version 1.0.19 it is separate from Reels tab, and the magnifier still opens search for people and accounts). It is free, it stays on until you turn it off, and DMs, posts from people you follow and search keep working.


## Instagram Following feed only (en, checked 2026-10-23)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/instagram-following-feed-only.html

Q: How do I see only posts from people I follow on Instagram?
A: Tap Instagram at the top left of your feed, then tap Following. Instagram's help says this shows posts from people you follow, with newer posts at the top. Meta says there are no suggested posts in this view and you can see the last 30 days.

Q: Can I make Instagram open to the Following feed by default?
A: We could not find a setting for this in Instagram's help as of October 2026. Instagram's help on Feed says that when you close and reopen Instagram or refresh your feed, the posts it predicts are most relevant to you appear toward the top. Plan on choosing Following again when you come back.

Q: What is the difference between Following and Favorites?
A: Following shows posts from everyone you follow. Favorites shows only the accounts you add to your Favorites list, up to 50, and their posts also appear higher in your main feed. Both are in time order and open from the Instagram menu at the top of your feed.

Q: Does the Following feed get rid of Reels and Explore?
A: No. Following changes your feed only. The Reels tab and Explore still show recommendations from accounts you don't follow. To hide them, open Instagram in an app that hides Reels and Explore, such as minulo, where this is free.

Q: How do I use Instagram without the algorithm?
A: Instagram has no switch that turns recommendations off everywhere. The Following and Favorites feeds are in time order, but Reels and Explore are still ranked for you. In minulo you can hide suggested posts, Reels and Explore for free, so what is left is your DMs, posts from people you follow and search.


## Blocking Instagram on iPhone (en, checked 2026-10-23)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/block-instagram-on-iphone.html

Q: How do I block Instagram on my iPhone?
A: Use Screen Time. On iOS 26, go to Settings > Screen Time > App Limits, add a limit for Instagram, set a Screen Time passcode and turn on Block at End of Limit. On iOS 27, use Time Allowances and Screen Time Schedule instead. You can also delete the app, but that is the easiest block to undo.

Q: How do I block Instagram in Safari?
A: On iOS 26, go to Settings > Screen Time > Content & Privacy Restrictions and turn it on. Tap App Store, Media, Web, & Games > Web Content, select Limit Adult Websites and add instagram.com under Never Allow. On iOS 27, a Time Allowance also applies to a website the app declares as associated.

Q: Can I block Instagram but keep my DMs?
A: Not with Screen Time, which blocks the whole app, DMs included. Use an app that opens Instagram with Reels and Explore hidden. In minulo this is free and DMs keep working, and minulo can lock the official app with Screen Time for free for up to 2 hours per block.

Q: Why does Instagram still open after my time limit?
A: By default, Screen Time limits can be ignored once they are reached. Set a Screen Time passcode and turn on Block at End of Limit. Also check that Instagram is not in Always Allowed and that you are not using instagram.com in Safari.

Q: Can I block Instagram so that I can't undo it myself?
A: Only if someone else knows the passcode. If you set the Screen Time passcode yourself, you can enter it and remove the block, so ask a friend or family member to choose it. In minulo, Hard Mode (Pro) makes turning a block off take a few minutes on purpose.


## Blocking TikTok on iPhone (en, checked 2026-10-23)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/block-tiktok-on-iphone.html

Q: How do I block TikTok on my iPhone?
A: Screen Time can block TikTok on iPhone, but it blocks your TikTok messages too. If you only want For You gone, minulo is an iPhone app that opens TikTok with For You hidden while your messages keep working, and hiding is free. On iOS 26, go to Settings > Screen Time > App Limits, add a limit for TikTok, set a Screen Time passcode and turn on Block at End of Limit. On iOS 27, use Time Allowances and Screen Time Schedule instead. You can also delete the app, but that is the easiest block to undo.

Q: How do I block the TikTok website on iPhone?
A: On iOS 26, go to Settings > Screen Time > Content & Privacy Restrictions and turn it on. Tap App Store, Media, Web, & Games > Web Content, select Limit Adult Websites and add tiktok.com under Never Allow. On iOS 27, a Time Allowance also applies to a website the app declares as associated.

Q: Can I block TikTok but keep my messages?
A: Not with Screen Time, which blocks the whole app, messages included. Use an app that opens TikTok with For You hidden. In minulo this is free and messages keep working, and minulo can lock the official app with Screen Time for free for up to 2 hours per block.

Q: Why does TikTok still open after my time limit?
A: By default, Screen Time limits can be ignored once they are reached. Set a Screen Time passcode and turn on Block at End of Limit. Also check that TikTok is not in Always Allowed and that you are not using tiktok.com in Safari.

Q: Can I block TikTok so that I can't undo it myself?
A: Only if someone else knows the passcode. If you set the Screen Time passcode yourself, you can enter it and remove the block, so ask a friend or family member to choose it. In minulo, Hard Mode (Pro) makes turning a block off take a few minutes on purpose.


## Turning off Snapchat Spotlight (en, checked 2026-10-23)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/turn-off-snapchat-spotlight.html

Q: Can you turn off Spotlight on Snapchat?
A: We could not find a way in Snapchat's help as of October 2026. Spotlight stays in the tab bar at the bottom of the app. Snapchat's help says about Discover that you can't completely disable the section, and we found no setting for Spotlight either. To use Snapchat without Spotlight, open it in an app that hides it, such as minulo, where this is free.

Q: How do I turn off Spotlight notifications on Snapchat?
A: Tap your profile icon, tap the gear to open Settings, tap Notifications, and turn off each notification type you don't want. If the alerts are about comments on your own Spotlight Snaps, turn off Comments in the same Notifications screen. To stop every Snapchat notification, go to the iPhone Settings app, tap Notifications, tap Snapchat and turn off Allow Notifications.

Q: Can I make Snapchat open on a tab other than Spotlight?
A: Only with Snapchat+. Subscribers can open My Account, tap their Snapchat+ membership card, tap Home Tab and choose the tab the app opens on. Spotlight is still one tap away in the tab bar.

Q: Does hiding Snaps on Spotlight make it go away?
A: No. Snapchat says it treats hiding, skipping and reporting as signs that you don't enjoy that content and ranks it lower, but Spotlight keeps showing other Snaps. It works one Snap at a time.

Q: How do I hide Spotlight on Snapchat but keep my chats?
A: iPhone Screen Time limits the whole Snapchat app, chats included, so it does not help here. Use an app that opens Snapchat with Spotlight hidden. In minulo, hiding Spotlight and Discover is free, and chat opens straight from the home screen.


## Brick alternatives for iPhone (en, checked 2026-10-23)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/brick-alternative-iphone.html

Q: Is there a free alternative to Brick?
A: Yes. iPhone Screen Time is built in and free. Set your limits, then let a friend or family member create the Screen Time passcode and keep it, so you can't change the settings on your own. ScreenZen is also free (its only in-app purchases are tips) and can lock its own settings.

Q: How much does Brick cost?
A: On Brick's website in October 2026, Brick is $59, Brick Night is $129, and both together are $169. Brick says these are one-time purchases with no subscription, and the App Store app is free.

Q: Can I use Brick without the Brick device?
A: Not for its main feature. You start and end a session by tapping your phone on the device. If you need to get out without it, the app includes 5 Emergency Unbricks that unblock all apps.

Q: Which app is hardest to turn off without hardware?
A: Opal says its Deep Focus mode can't be bypassed or cancelled once it starts. Screen Time with a passcode only someone else knows is also hard to undo, as long as you don't add Passcode Recovery with your own Apple Account, since that lets you reset it yourself.

Q: What if I only want to stop Reels and Shorts, not block Instagram?
A: Brick, Opal and Screen Time block the whole app, so DMs are blocked too. minulo opens Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and 7 other networks with Reels, Shorts and suggested posts hidden, and DMs keep working. Hiding is free.



## Turning off the TikTok For You page (en, checked 2026-10-23)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/turn-off-tiktok-for-you-page.html

Q: How do you turn off the TikTok For You page on iPhone?
A: TikTok has no setting that turns off the For You page. minulo is an iPhone app that opens TikTok with For You hidden while your messages keep working, and hiding is free. We could not find a way in TikTok's help as of October 2026. For You is the first feed you see when you open TikTok, and TikTok's tools (Refresh your For You feed, Not interested, Filter keywords and Manage topics) change what it shows without removing it.

Q: What does Refresh your For You feed do?
A: It starts your For You recommendations over. TikTok shows you some popular posts, and what you like and comment on shapes the feed from there. It only affects For You, not your Following feed, profile, inbox or ads, and it can't be undone. You find it under Profile, Menu, Settings and privacy, Content preferences.

Q: Can I use TikTok with only the Following feed?
A: Not in the TikTok app. It still opens on For You, and when you run out of posts in Following or the Friends Tab, TikTok suggests going to For You. In minulo you can hide For You, and Messages and Following open straight from its home screen.

Q: Does TikTok's daily screen time limit stop you from scrolling?
A: Not by itself. When you reach the limit, TikTok notifies you and you can close the app or type the passcode shown on the screen to keep watching, so it works as a reminder. For users aged 13 to 17 it is on by default at 1 hour.

Q: How do I stop scrolling TikTok but keep my DMs?
A: Limiting the TikTok app with iPhone Screen Time blocks your messages too. Instead, open TikTok in an app that hides For You and keeps messages, such as minulo. Hiding is free, and minulo can also lock the official TikTok app for up to 2 hours per block for free, so tapping its icon sends you to minulo.


## What minulo can't do (en, checked 2026-10-23)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/minulo-limitations.html

Q: What are the downsides of minulo?
A: minulo can't change the official apps, so Reels and Shorts are hidden only inside minulo. While it blocks an official app, that app's notifications don't arrive, and minulo sends none of its own. Since version 1.0.19, Pro users can turn on DM notifications (beta) so Instagram DM notifications still arrive while Instagram is blocked, except during Sleep mode, Work mode or after the daily limit. Posting Stories, voice messages and calls aren't available. It is iPhone and Mac (Safari and Chrome) only, free blocks last up to 2 hours, and it is new, with few ratings.

Q: Can minulo remove Reels from the official Instagram app?
A: No. On iPhone, no app can change what another app shows. minulo hides Reels when you open Instagram inside minulo, and it can lock the official app with Screen Time so tapping its icon sends you to minulo instead.

Q: Will I still get Instagram notifications if I use minulo?
A: Only if the official Instagram app is not blocked. Notifications come from the official app, and they don't arrive while minulo blocks it. Since version 1.0.19, Pro users can turn on DM notifications (beta) so Instagram DM notifications still arrive while Instagram is blocked, except during Sleep mode, Work mode or after the daily limit. minulo itself sends no push notifications.

Q: What is free in minulo and what needs Pro?
A: Hiding Reels, Shorts and suggested posts on all 10 networks and blocking the official apps for up to 2 hours at a time are free. Pro adds Sleep mode (one bedtime and wake time, the same every day), Work mode (pick your workdays and hours), Hard Mode (breaks only once a day), a Daily limit and blocks longer than 2 hours. In the US it is $9.99 a month or $39.99 a year, and the yearly plan comes with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers.

Q: Does minulo work on Android?
A: Not yet. minulo is for iPhone and Mac, and the Mac app works in Safari and Chrome. The Android version is in testing, and you can join the waitlist to get one email when it is out.


## Hide, block or delete Instagram (en, checked 2026-10-23)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/hide-block-or-delete-instagram.html

Q: Should I delete Instagram or just block Reels?
A: If you need Instagram for messages, hiding only Reels usually lasts longer than deleting, because you never have to reinstall it to answer a DM. Deleting fits a short, clear period such as exam week, or an app you don't use for messages. You can also do both halfway: hide Reels with an app like minulo and lock the official Instagram app with Screen Time.

Q: Why don't app blockers work for me?
A: Usually for one of three reasons. Screen Time limits can be ignored by default unless you set a Screen Time passcode and turn on Block at Downtime. If you chose the passcode yourself, you can type it in. And a full block also stops DMs, so you unblock to reply and then stay on the feed. Letting someone else set the passcode, or keeping DMs in an app without Reels, fixes most of this.

Q: Does a pause before opening an app actually work?
A: There is evidence that it helps. In a 6-week field experiment with 280 one sec users published in PNAS in 2023, people closed the app 36% of the times one sec interrupted them, and opening of the chosen apps fell by 57% after six weeks. One of the authors is one sec's creator. After the pause the whole app opens, so if you do go in, Reels are still there.

Q: Can I keep Instagram DMs but get rid of Reels?
A: Not inside the official Instagram app, which no other iPhone app can change. Apps such as minulo, SocialLite and UNDOOMED open Instagram in their own view with Reels and suggested posts hidden while DMs keep working. In minulo this is free, and it can also lock the official Instagram app so you end up in the version without Reels.

Q: Is hiding the feed enough on its own?
A: Often not, because the official app is still on your phone with Reels in it. Hiding only works inside the app that does the hiding. Pair it with a lock on the official app (minulo does this with Screen Time, free for up to 2 hours per block) or move the official app off your Home Screen.


## Reels and Shorts time calculator (en, checked 2026-10-23)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/reels-time-calculator.html · es https://minulo.app/es/reels-time-calculator.html · pt https://minulo.app/pt/reels-time-calculator.html · de https://minulo.app/de/reels-time-calculator.html · th https://minulo.app/th/reels-time-calculator.html

Q: How many hours a year is one hour a day on Reels?
A: 365 hours, which is about 15.2 full days, or 7 hours a week. The formula is minutes a day × 365 ÷ 60.

Q: How do I work out how many years of my life go to short videos?
A: Multiply your minutes a day by 365 and divide by 60 to get hours per year, then multiply by the number of years up to the age you choose. Divide by 24 for days, or by 8,760 for years. For example, 60 minutes a day from age 20 to 80 is 21,900 hours, about 2.5 years.

Q: Where can I see my daily time on Instagram or TikTok?
A: On iPhone, go to Settings > Screen Time, tap Daily Average, then choose Week or Day to see a summary of your usage.

Q: Does this calculator save or send what I type?
A: No. The calculation runs in your browser, and the numbers you type aren't saved or sent anywhere.



## Why Reels and Shorts are hard to stop (en, checked 2026-10-23)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/why-reels-are-addictive.html

Q: Why are Reels and short videos so addictive?
A: Mostly because of the design. The next video plays as soon as you swipe, the feed never ends, you can't tell whether the next one will be good, nothing on screen counts the time, and the recommendations learn from what you just watched. Instagram and YouTube describe these features themselves. Feeling hooked isn't a diagnosis; it's a sign the feed is doing what it was built to do.

Q: Why can't I stop scrolling Reels even when I'm bored?
A: Because every swipe might bring a really good video, and finding one now and then keeps you going. Researchers compare this to intermittent rewards. There's also no last video and no clock in the feed, so there's never a natural moment to stop.

Q: Are short videos bad for your attention?
A: A 2025 review of 71 studies found that heavier short-form video use was associated with poorer attention and self-control and with more stress and anxiety. Most of those studies were cross-sectional, so they can't show that short videos cause these problems; it could also be that stressed people watch more.

Q: Does YouTube's Shorts feed limit stop Shorts?
A: Not completely. You can set it to 0 under You > Settings > Time management > Shorts feed limit, but when you reach the limit YouTube shows a reminder you can dismiss or ignore. It's a reminder, not a block.

Q: Can I keep Instagram DMs but get rid of Reels?
A: Not inside the Instagram app, but you can with minulo. It opens Instagram with Reels, Explore and suggested posts hidden while your DMs keep working, and hiding them is free. It does the same for YouTube Shorts and TikTok's For You feed.



## How to get rid of the For you tab on X (en, checked 2026-10-24)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/turn-off-x-for-you.html

Q: Can I turn off the For you tab on X?
A: We could not find a setting that removes it in X's help as of October 2026. You can switch to Following, and X reopens on the timeline you had open last when you closed it. To have the For you tab hidden every time, open X in an app that hides it, such as minulo, where this is free.

Q: How do I make X open to Following instead of For you?
A: Switch to Following at the top of Home and close X while you are still on it. X's help says the app reopens on whichever timeline you had open last. If you look at For you before closing, it will open on For you next time.

Q: Why does X keep going back to For you?
A: X remembers the tab you were on when you closed the app. If you swiped over to For you, even briefly, that is the tab you get next time. X may also show recommended posts in notifications, which can take you back into recommended content.

Q: Does muting words remove posts from For you?
A: Muted words apply to your Home timeline and notifications, so posts containing them are kept out of Home. Muted posts still appear in search, and notifications you turned on for a specific account are not muted. You add entries one at a time and can mute them forever or for 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days.

Q: Can I use X just for DMs?
A: X has no setting for that. Screen Time blocks the whole app, messages included. In minulo, X opens to Messages with the For you tab hidden, and Search, Video and Grok can be hidden too. Hiding is free.




## How to stop seeing Threads posts on Instagram (en, checked 2026-10-24)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/stop-threads-posts-on-instagram.html · th https://minulo.app/th/stop-threads-posts-on-instagram.html

Q: Why are Threads posts showing up in my Instagram feed?
A: Meta shows Threads posts directly on Instagram and Facebook. Instagram head Adam Mosseri announced the feature in November 2023 as a way to help Threads posts reach more people. They can come from accounts you don't follow.

Q: Can I turn off Threads posts on Instagram completely?
A: We could not find a setting for this in Instagram's help as of October 2026. You can hide Threads posts one at a time from their menu, or switch to the Following feed, which shows only accounts you follow. If you mainly use Instagram for DMs, minulo can open it with the whole feed hidden, for free.

Q: Does "Suggesting posts on other apps" stop Threads on Instagram?
A: Not for what you see. That Threads setting controls whether your own Threads posts are suggested on Instagram and Facebook. Other people's Threads posts can still appear in your Instagram feed.

Q: Does the Following feed remove Threads posts?
A: Following shows posts only from accounts you follow, with no suggested posts, so Threads posts that Instagram suggests from other accounts are not shown there. Instagram goes back to the regular feed when you reopen it, so you choose Following each time.

Q: How do I stop Threads notifications on Instagram?
A: Guiding Tech says you can swipe left on a Threads notification in Instagram's Notifications tab, tap the three dots and choose Turn off notifications like this. We could not find this step in Instagram's help.




## Why Instagram opens to Reels (en, checked 2026-10-24)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/instagram-opens-to-reels.html · th https://minulo.app/th/instagram-opens-to-reels.html

Q: Why does my Instagram open to Reels now?
A: Instagram has been testing Reels-first layouts. In October 2025 it let a small group in India make Reels and DMs the first two tabs, and in October 2026 it was reported testing an option to open straight to the Reels feed. Both were described as optional. On iPad, the Instagram app opens to Reels by design.

Q: How do I make Instagram open to my feed again?
A: If you opted into a Reels-first test, switch back; Instagram said you can leave these tests, but we could not confirm the exact menu in its help. Otherwise tap Home to get to your feed, and tap Instagram at the top left › Following to see only people you follow. Instagram doesn't remember Following, so you choose it again each time.

Q: Can I remove the Reels tab from Instagram?
A: No. We could not find a setting in Instagram's help that removes the Reels tab as of October 2026. To use Instagram without it, open Instagram in an app that hides the Reels tab, such as minulo, where this is free and DMs keep working.

Q: Why does Instagram on iPad open to Reels?
A: Instagram designed its iPad app that way. When it launched in September 2025, Instagram said that when you open the app you drop into Reels, with Stories at the top and messages one tap away. The iPad app also has a Following tab with All, Friends and Latest views.

Q: How do I open Instagram straight to DMs?
A: We found no setting in the Instagram app for this. In minulo, Messages opens straight from the minulo home screen, and you can turn on Every tab but DMs so only DMs and notifications are left. Hiding is free.

## Instagram Quiet Mode Is Now Sleep Mode: How to Turn It On (en, checked 2026-10-24)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/instagram-quiet-mode.html · ja https://minulo.app/instagram-quiet-mode.html · ko https://minulo.app/ko/instagram-quiet-mode.html · es https://minulo.app/es/instagram-quiet-mode.html · pt-BR https://minulo.app/pt/instagram-quiet-mode.html · de https://minulo.app/de/instagram-quiet-mode.html · fr https://minulo.app/fr/instagram-quiet-mode.html

Instagram's Quiet mode is still there, under a new name: Sleep mode. Meta says the feature launched as Quiet mode in January 2023 and was renamed later. To turn it on, go to your profile, tap the menu at the top right, then Time management › Sleep mode, and pick the days and hours. During that time Instagram pauses your notifications and sends an auto-reply to people who message you. It does not lock the app, so you can still open Reels at 1 a.m. If you want Reels gone at night as well, minulo can hide them for free.
Names: Japanese UI スリープモード (Settings and activity › Time management = ［設定とアクティビティ］→［時間管理］); Korean UI 사용 제한 모드 (설정 및 활동 › 시간 관리), not 방해금지모드. Meta Newsroom (2023-01-19, updated 2025-01-28) says Quiet mode is now called Sleep mode.

Q: Does Instagram still have Quiet mode?
A: Yes, under a new name. Meta says the feature launched as Quiet mode in 2023 and has since been renamed Sleep mode. You find it under Profile › Menu › Time management › Sleep mode.

Q: How do I turn off Sleep mode on Instagram?
A: Go to your profile, tap Menu at the top right, tap Time management, then Sleep mode, and switch the toggle off. Changes are saved automatically.

Q: Can people see that I'm in Sleep mode?
A: Yes. Your activity status changes to "In sleep mode", the green dot becomes a moon icon, and people who message you get an auto-reply saying you won't be notified.

Q: Do I still get messages in Sleep mode?
A: Messages still come in and you can open them. You just aren't notified. When Sleep mode ends, Instagram shows a summary of new notifications and messages.

Q: Does Sleep mode stop me from watching Reels?
A: No. Sleep mode pauses notifications and shows a reminder, but you can still open Instagram and watch Reels. To hide Reels, open Instagram in an app that hides them, such as minulo, or block the app with Screen Time.


## How to Temporarily Deactivate Instagram on iPhone (2026) (en, checked 2026-10-24)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/deactivate-instagram-temporarily.html · ja https://minulo.app/deactivate-instagram-temporarily.html · ko https://minulo.app/ko/deactivate-instagram-temporarily.html · es https://minulo.app/es/deactivate-instagram-temporarily.html · pt-BR https://minulo.app/pt/deactivate-instagram-temporarily.html · de https://minulo.app/de/deactivate-instagram-temporarily.html · fr https://minulo.app/fr/deactivate-instagram-temporarily.html · th https://minulo.app/th/deactivate-instagram-temporarily.html

To temporarily deactivate Instagram on iPhone, go to your profile › Menu › Accounts Center › Manage account, tap Manage next to your Instagram profile, then Deactivation or deletion › Deactivate account. Your photos, comments and likes are hidden until you log back in, and you can only do this once a week. Logging back in is what reactivates the account, so you can't deactivate and still check your DMs. If you mainly want to stop scrolling Reels, blocking the app or hiding Reels leaves your account and messages as they are.
Names: Japanese help calls it 利用解除 (［アカウントセンター］→［アカウントを管理］→［管理］→［利用解除または削除］→［アカウントを利用解除］); Korean 비활성화 (계정 센터 › 계정 관리 › 관리 › 비활성화 또는 삭제 › 계정 비활성화). Deletion is permanent 30 days after the request.

Q: How do I temporarily deactivate my Instagram?
A: On iPhone, go to Profile › Menu › Accounts Center › Manage account, tap Manage next to your profile, then Deactivation or deletion › Deactivate account › Continue. If your Accounts Center shows Accounts at the bottom, the path is Personal details › Account ownership and control › Deactivation or deletion.

Q: What happens when you deactivate Instagram?
A: Your profile, photos, comments and likes are hidden until you reactivate by logging back in. Nothing is deleted.

Q: How long can I deactivate Instagram for?
A: Instagram's help gives no time limit. The account stays deactivated until you log back in.

Q: Can I still use DMs if I deactivate Instagram?
A: Not without ending the break. Logging back in reactivates the account. To keep DMs and stop Reels, block or hide Reels instead, for example with minulo.

Q: How often can I deactivate Instagram?
A: Once a week, according to Instagram's help.


## How to See Time Spent on Instagram on iPhone (2026) (en, checked 2026-10-24)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/instagram-time-spent.html · ja https://minulo.app/instagram-time-spent.html · ko https://minulo.app/ko/instagram-time-spent.html · es https://minulo.app/es/instagram-time-spent.html · pt-BR https://minulo.app/pt/instagram-time-spent.html · de https://minulo.app/de/instagram-time-spent.html · fr https://minulo.app/fr/instagram-time-spent.html · th https://minulo.app/th/instagram-time-spent.html

To see your time on Instagram, go to your profile › Menu › Your activity › Time management. Instagram shows your average daily time over the last 7 days, counted from when you open the app until you close it or switch to another app. For a day-by-day number, use iPhone Screen Time: Settings › Screen Time › Daily Average, then Day or Week. Instagram's Daily limit, on the same screen, only sends a reminder; it doesn't lock the app unless a parent supervises a Teen Account. Neither tells you how much of that time went to Reels.
Names: Japanese ［時間管理］ (the daily limit article says ［利用時間］), daily limit ［1日の上限］; Korean 시간 관리, 일일 시간 제한. Not available on computers.

Q: How do I see how much time I spend on Instagram?
A: Go to your profile, tap Menu at the top right, then Time management under How you use Instagram (it may be inside Your activity). Instagram shows your average daily time over the last 7 days. For daily numbers, use iPhone Settings › Screen Time › Daily Average.

Q: Can I see time spent on Instagram on a computer?
A: No. Instagram's help says the time spent feature isn't available on computers, only in the iPhone, iPad and Android apps.

Q: How do I set a daily time limit on Instagram?
A: Go to Profile › Menu › Time management › Daily limit, choose a time and tap back. Instagram reminds you when you reach it.

Q: Does Instagram's daily limit block the app?
A: No. For most people it is only a reminder. Only Teen Accounts supervised by a parent can be blocked when the limit is reached. To stop the app itself, use Screen Time.

Q: Why is my Instagram time different from Screen Time?
A: Instagram shows a 7-day average from the Instagram app. Screen Time shows each day, and with Share Across Devices on, it includes your iPad and Mac. The numbers measure different things, so they often differ.


## How to Get Instagram Notifications Only for Messages (iPhone) (en, checked 2026-10-24)

## TikTok Screen Time Limit: How to Set It and Make It Stick (2026) (en, checked 2026-10-24)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/tiktok-screen-time-limit.html · ja https://minulo.app/tiktok-screen-time-limit.html · ko https://minulo.app/ko/tiktok-screen-time-limit.html · es https://minulo.app/es/tiktok-screen-time-limit.html · pt-BR https://minulo.app/pt/tiktok-screen-time-limit.html · de https://minulo.app/de/tiktok-screen-time-limit.html · fr https://minulo.app/fr/tiktok-screen-time-limit.html

TikTok's daily screen time is under Profile › Menu › Settings and privacy › Time and well-being › Screen time. When you reach the limit, TikTok notifies you and you can close the app or type the passcode shown on the screen to keep watching, so it is a reminder, not a lock. For users aged 13 to 17 it is on by default at 1 hour. To be blocked at the limit, use iPhone Screen Time with a passcode someone else sets. If the For You feed is the problem, minulo hides it and keeps your messages, for free.

Q: Where is the screen time limit on TikTok?
A: In the TikTok app, tap Profile, then the Menu button (☰), then Settings and privacy, Time and well-being and Screen time, and turn on Daily screen time. On the web, click your profile picture, then Settings, Screen time and Daily screen time. TikTok says the setting applies to both the app and the web.

Q: Why is my TikTok screen time limit not working?
A: It is working the way TikTok describes it. When you reach the limit, TikTok notifies you and you can either close the app or type the passcode shown on the screen to keep watching. Because the passcode is right there on the screen, the limit works as a reminder, not a lock.

Q: Why does the TikTok screen time limit keep popping up?
A: TikTok turns Daily screen time on by default, at 1 hour, for users aged 13 to 17. If you set a limit yourself, the notice appears each day you reach it. You can switch the limit off in Settings and privacy, Time and well-being, Screen time. Daily screen time can also be set through Family Pairing.

Q: How do I remove the TikTok screen time limit?
A: Go to Profile, Menu (☰), Settings and privacy, Time and well-being, Screen time, open Daily screen time and switch the time limit off. On the web it is under your profile picture, Settings, Screen time, Daily screen time.

Q: Can TikTok lock me out when the time is up?
A: We could not find a lock in TikTok's help. Its own limit lets you keep watching with an on-screen passcode. To be blocked at the limit, use iPhone Screen Time: on iOS 26, add an App Limit for TikTok, set a Screen Time passcode and turn on Block at End of Limit. It only holds if someone else knows the passcode. This blocks TikTok messages too.


## How to Set a Time Limit on YouTube for Yourself (iPhone, 2026) (en, checked 2026-10-24)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/youtube-time-limit.html · ja https://minulo.app/youtube-time-limit.html · ko https://minulo.app/ko/youtube-time-limit.html · es https://minulo.app/es/youtube-time-limit.html · pt-BR https://minulo.app/pt/youtube-time-limit.html · de https://minulo.app/de/youtube-time-limit.html · fr https://minulo.app/fr/youtube-time-limit.html

We could not find a daily time limit in YouTube's help that locks you out of your own account. What YouTube has are reminders: Remind me to take a break, Remind me when it's bedtime and the Shorts feed limit. Each one can be dismissed, and you keep watching. To be stopped at a set time, use iPhone Screen Time with Block at End of Limit and a passcode someone else holds. If Shorts and Home recommendations are what take the time, minulo shows YouTube with them hidden and keeps your subscriptions, for free.

Q: Does YouTube have a daily time limit?
A: Not one that locks you out. We could not find a daily limit for your own account in YouTube's help as of October 2026. YouTube has reminders instead: Remind me to take a break, Remind me when it's bedtime and the Shorts feed limit. You can dismiss each one and keep watching. Supervised accounts for kids and teens have separate controls run by a parent.

Q: How do I set a time limit on YouTube on iPhone?
A: For a reminder, tap your profile picture in the YouTube app, then Settings, General, and turn on Remind me to take a break. For a real limit, use iPhone Screen Time: on iOS 26, add an App Limit for YouTube, set a Screen Time passcode and turn on Block at End of Limit. On iOS 27, use Time Allowances.

Q: How do I turn off the YouTube take a break reminder?
A: Tap your profile picture, then Settings, General, and switch off Remind me to take a break. You can also tap Change break reminder when a reminder appears. YouTube's help says the reminder is on by default for users aged 13 to 17 and off for users 18 and over.

Q: Why doesn't YouTube's reminder stop me from watching?
A: Because it is only a reminder. The take a break reminder pauses the video until you dismiss it, and one tap lets you keep watching. The timer also resets if you close the app, sign out, switch devices or pause a video for more than 30 minutes. The bedtime reminder can be closed or snoozed for 15 minutes.

Q: Can I limit only YouTube Shorts?
A: YouTube has a Shorts feed limit under Settings, Time management. You can set it to 0, but when you reach it YouTube lets you dismiss or ignore the limit. To have Shorts gone with nothing to tap past, watch YouTube in minulo with Shorts hidden. That is free.


## How to Turn Off Recommendations on Reddit (Home Feed, 2026) (en, checked 2026-10-24)
Source: ko https://minulo.app/ko/turn-off-reddit-recommendations.html

Reddit does let you turn off home feed recommendations. In the app, open your account settings, scroll down to Privacy and turn off Show recommendations in home feed. On reddit.com the same toggle is in your preferences. Reddit says these recommendations appear when Home is sorted by Best. The toggle is about Home only: the Popular feed, community suggestions and trending post notifications are separate. If you'd rather not see Popular at all, minulo opens Reddit with Popular, r/all and suggested posts hidden, for free.

Q: Can you turn off recommendations on Reddit?
A: Yes, for your home feed. Reddit's help says you can turn off the toggle Show recommendations in home feed: in the app it is in your account settings under Privacy, and on reddit.com it is in your preferences. Reddit describes this as stopping recommended content from communities you aren't subscribed to in your home feed. Other places, such as the Popular feed and trending notifications, have their own settings.

Q: Where is Show recommendations in home feed on iPhone?
A: Open your account settings in the Reddit app and scroll down to Privacy. Reddit's help gives the way into account settings on iOS as: tap your avatar, tap the menu (three lines), choose Settings, then tap your username under Account Settings.

Q: Why do I still see communities I don't follow on Reddit?
A: Check whether you are on Home or on Popular. Popular shows the most upvoted recent posts across Reddit, whatever you follow. Q: How do I stop recommended subreddits from coming back?
A: Tap the overflow menu on a recommended post and choose Show fewer posts like this. Reddit says it then stops recommending posts from that community and shows fewer from similar ones. To hide a community completely from Home, Popular and notifications, mute it. You can mute up to 1,000 communities.

Q: How do I turn off Reddit trending notifications?
A: In the app, tap your avatar, the menu (three lines), Settings, then your username under Account Settings, and tap Manage Notifications. Under Recommendations, switch off Trending posts. On reddit.com it is Settings, Notifications, Recommendations, Trending Posts. You can't turn them off for just one community.

## Do Short Videos Ruin Your Attention Span? What Studies Show (en, checked 2026-10-24)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/short-videos-attention-span.html · ja https://minulo.app/short-videos-attention-span.html · ko https://minulo.app/ko/short-videos-attention-span.html · es https://minulo.app/es/short-videos-attention-span.html · pt-BR https://minulo.app/pt/short-videos-attention-span.html · de https://minulo.app/de/short-videos-attention-span.html · fr https://minulo.app/fr/short-videos-attention-span.html

Research links heavy short video use with poorer attention, but it hasn't shown that short videos cause it. A 2025 review of 71 studies (98,299 people) found that people who watch more short videos tend to score lower on attention and self-control, and most of that evidence is correlation. A small 2023 experiment found that a TikTok break made people worse at remembering to do something they had planned, and a 2025 trial found that blocking mobile internet for two weeks improved sustained attention. So cutting back is a reasonable bet, not a proven cure.

Q: Do short videos really reduce attention span?
A: They are linked, but cause and effect isn't proven. A 2025 review of 71 studies found that heavier short video use went with poorer attention and self-control. Most of the studies were correlational, so people who already find it hard to focus might simply watch more.

Q: Is TikTok worse for attention than YouTube?
A: One 2023 lab study with 60 people found that a TikTok break hurt memory for planned actions while YouTube and Twitter breaks didn't. The 2025 review found similar links across short video platforms, including Reels and Shorts. There isn't enough evidence to rank the apps.

Q: Can you get your attention span back?
A: In a 2025 trial, people who blocked mobile internet on their iPhones for two weeks did better on a sustained attention test. That study blocked all mobile internet, not only short videos, and most participants didn't block every day. It suggests cutting back can make a difference within weeks.

Q: How much short video is too much?
A: No study has set a safe number of minutes. The research compares people who watch more with people who watch less. Your own Screen Time report is a better guide: if the time is more than you would choose, or you can't focus on things you want to do, that is a reason to cut back.

Q: Can I block Reels and Shorts but keep Instagram and YouTube?
A: Yes. On iPhone, minulo opens Instagram and YouTube with Reels and Shorts hidden while DMs, search and regular videos keep working. Hiding them is free.


## Am I Addicted to My Phone? A Self-Check With Screen Time (en, checked 2026-10-24)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/phone-addiction-self-check.html · ja https://minulo.app/phone-addiction-self-check.html · ko https://minulo.app/ko/phone-addiction-self-check.html · es https://minulo.app/es/phone-addiction-self-check.html · pt-BR https://minulo.app/pt/phone-addiction-self-check.html · de https://minulo.app/de/phone-addiction-self-check.html · fr https://minulo.app/fr/phone-addiction-self-check.html · th https://minulo.app/th/phone-addiction-self-check.html

There is no official number of hours or pickups that means you are addicted to your phone, and the questionnaires researchers use say they measure risk rather than diagnose. You can still check yourself in two ways. First, read a week of Screen Time: daily average, pickups, notifications and your top apps. Second, answer a short validated questionnaire such as the 10-item Smartphone Addiction Scale (SAS-SV). If the numbers are higher than you would choose, start with the app at the top of your list.

Q: How do I know if I'm addicted to my phone?
A: There is no single test. Look at a week of Screen Time (daily average, pickups, top apps) and answer a validated questionnaire such as the 10-item SAS-SV. Its authors say it identifies risk rather than diagnosing addiction. If phone use is causing problems you can't fix on your own, talk to a doctor or counselor.

Q: How many phone pickups a day is normal?
A: There is no official normal number. Apple shows your pickups but doesn't set a target, and I haven't found a study that does. Compare your own weeks, and notice which app you open first after picking up.

Q: Where can I see my pickups on iPhone?
A: Open Settings > Screen Time > Daily Average, choose Week or Day, and scroll down to Pickups and Notifications.

Q: What score on the SAS-SV means high risk?
A: In the original 2013 paper, 31 or more for boys and 33 or more for girls, out of 60. The authors say the scale screens for risk and isn't designed to diagnose.

Q: What should I do if my screen time is too high?
A: Start with the app at the top of your list. If it is Instagram, YouTube or TikTok, removing only the endless feed (Reels, Shorts or For You) lets you keep your messages. On iPhone, minulo does this for free. Check Screen Time again after a week.


## How to Do a Digital Detox for a Week (Without Going Offline) (en, checked 2026-10-24)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/digital-detox-one-week.html · ja https://minulo.app/digital-detox-one-week.html · ko https://minulo.app/ko/digital-detox-one-week.html · es https://minulo.app/es/digital-detox-one-week.html · pt-BR https://minulo.app/pt/digital-detox-one-week.html · de https://minulo.app/de/digital-detox-one-week.html · fr https://minulo.app/fr/digital-detox-one-week.html

A digital detox doesn't have to mean switching your phone off. If you want it to last a week, keep calls, messages and maps, and cut the parts that eat the time: Reels, Shorts, TikTok's For You feed and the habit of checking. Plan it the evening before, block the feeds instead of relying on willpower, and decide what you will do with the free evenings. Two studies found real benefits from two- and four-week breaks, and both also show how hard it is to stick to one.

Q: How do you do a digital detox for a week?
A: Keep calls, messages and the apps you need, and cut the feeds that take the most time. Write down your Screen Time before you start, hide or delete the feed apps, set Downtime for the evenings, plan what you will do instead, and compare your Screen Time at the end of the week.

Q: Can you do a digital detox without giving up your phone?
A: Yes. Removing the endless feeds and keeping messages is a detox most people can keep up. In a 2025 trial, people kept calls and texts and blocked only mobile internet for two weeks, and their attention and well-being improved.

Q: What are the benefits of a digital detox?
A: In a 2020 experiment, people who deactivated Facebook for four weeks reported higher well-being and used Facebook less afterwards. In a 2025 trial, two weeks without mobile internet improved sustained attention, mental health and well-being. Both studies used volunteers, and many found it hard to stick to the break.

Q: What should I do instead of scrolling during a digital detox?
A: Decide before you start. A walk, a book, cooking, exercise or seeing friends all work, as long as it is planned. In the 2020 Facebook study, people spent the time they got back watching TV and with friends and family.

Q: Can I keep Instagram DMs during a digital detox?
A: Yes, with minulo on iPhone. Turn on Every tab but DMs for Instagram and only DMs and notifications stay, while Reels, Explore and the feed are hidden. Hiding is free.


## How to Stop Scrolling at Work: iPhone Settings That Help (en, checked 2026-10-24)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/stop-scrolling-at-work.html · ja https://minulo.app/stop-scrolling-at-work.html · ko https://minulo.app/ko/stop-scrolling-at-work.html · es https://minulo.app/es/stop-scrolling-at-work.html · pt-BR https://minulo.app/pt/stop-scrolling-at-work.html · de https://minulo.app/de/stop-scrolling-at-work.html · fr https://minulo.app/fr/stop-scrolling-at-work.html · th https://minulo.app/th/stop-scrolling-at-work.html

Scrolling at work usually starts in a small gap: a file is loading, a meeting hasn't started, a task feels hard. The phone is on the desk, so you pick it up. What helps is making the feed harder to reach during work hours without cutting yourself off from messages. On iPhone, a Work Focus can keep social apps quiet and switch to a Home Screen page without them, and a Screen Time limit can stop those apps opening. If you need Instagram for work, hide only Reels, Explore and suggested posts instead.

Q: How do I stop scrolling on my phone at work?
A: Make the feed harder to reach during work hours. Turn on a Work Focus that keeps social apps quiet and shows a Home Screen page without them, set a Screen Time limit for those apps, and keep the phone out of reach. If you need Instagram for work, hide Reels and Explore instead of blocking the whole app.

Q: Does a Work Focus block apps on iPhone?
A: No. A Focus controls which apps can send notifications and can switch your Home Screen page, but you can still open any app. To stop apps from opening, use a Screen Time App Limit or Downtime with blocking.

Q: Why do I keep checking my phone at work?
A: Usually because of short gaps: waiting for a reply, a loading screen, or a task you don't want to start. The phone is within reach, and Reels and Shorts are made to fill a minute or two. Moving the phone and quieting social apps removes many of those prompts.

Q: How can I use Instagram for work without getting distracted?
A: Use it without the feed. On iPhone, minulo opens Instagram with Reels, Explore and suggested posts hidden while posting, comments and DMs keep working. Hiding is free. Stories and calls still need the official app.

Q: Can I block social media only during work hours?
A: Yes. Use a Screen Time Downtime schedule or App Limit for your working hours, or minulo's blocking, which is free for up to 2 hours per block. With minulo Pro a block can last longer than 2 hours, and a Daily limit caps social media time each day.



## How to Open Instagram Straight to Your DMs (iPhone, 2026) (en, checked 2026-10-26)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/instagram-open-straight-to-dms.html

minulo opens Instagram with only your DMs and the notifications tab, and its Every tab but DMs setting is free. Instagram itself has no setting that makes the app open on your messages. Before you install anything, iPhone has three shortcuts worth trying: tap a message notification, which takes you to that chat; touch and hold the Instagram icon and see whether its Quick Actions menu has a messages item; and turn off Instagram's other notifications so the alerts you tap are DMs. They get you into a chat faster, but once you are in the app, the feed and Reels are still one tap away.

Q: Can I make Instagram open straight to my DMs?
A: Yes, with minulo: its free Every tab but DMs setting opens Instagram with only DMs and the notifications tab left. Instagram itself has no such setting. Tapping a message notification also opens that chat, but the feed and Reels are still in the app.

Q: Does holding the Instagram icon open DMs?
A: Only if a messages item appears in its Quick Actions menu. Instagram decides what is in that menu, and we couldn't confirm the current list: a 2015 report mentions a direct message shortcut, and a later guide lists Switch Accounts, Camera, New Post and View Activity.

Q: Can I reply to an Instagram DM from the Lock Screen?
A: Apple says touching and holding a notification shows quick actions if the app offers them. We couldn't confirm that Instagram offers a reply there. If it doesn't, tapping the notification opens the chat.

Q: How do I get Instagram notifications only for DMs?
A: Go to Profile › Menu › Notifications, and below Pause push notifications turn off each kind that isn't about messages. Leave messages on and keep Instagram allowed in iPhone Settings › Notifications.

Q: Will I still get DM notifications if I use minulo?
A: Yes, from the official Instagram app, as long as minulo isn't locking it. While minulo locks the official app, its notifications don't arrive, and minulo sends none of its own. Since version 1.0.19, Pro users can turn on DM notifications (beta) so Instagram DM notifications still arrive while Instagram is blocked, except during Sleep mode, Work mode or after the daily limit.


## Hide the YouTube Shorts Shelf: How Long It Lasts (iPhone) (en, checked 2026-10-26)

minulo hides the Shorts shelf and the Shorts tab for free, and they stay hidden until you change the setting. In YouTube itself, the X on the Shorts shelf only hides it for a while: news reports quote YouTube's message as "Shelf will be hidden for 30 days", but YouTube's help doesn't describe the X or give a period. The X isn't on every screen either. SlashGear (2023) found it on the mobile website and the desktop site, and tbreak (April 2026) on the mobile website only; both say it isn't in the app. GeekChamp (May 2026) says it appears in the app for some accounts. Hiding the shelf leaves Shorts in the Shorts tab, search, Subscriptions, channel pages and notifications. What YouTube's help does describe for the app is Show fewer Shorts and the Shorts feed limit.

Q: How do I hide the Shorts shelf on YouTube for good?
A: minulo hides the Shorts shelf and the Shorts tab for free and keeps them hidden until you change the setting, though only inside minulo. We found no permanent switch in YouTube's help; the X on the shelf hides it for 30 days, according to news reports.

Q: How long does the X hide YouTube Shorts?
A: 30 days, according to SlashGear and GeekChamp, which quote the message YouTube shows. YouTube's help doesn't mention the X or a period, so treat the 30 days as reported, not official.

Q: Why is there no X on my Shorts shelf?
A: Reports say it isn't on every account. tbreak (April 2026) found it only on the mobile website, and GeekChamp (May 2026) says it depends on account, region and app version. In the app, tap More at the top of the Shorts grid and choose Show fewer Shorts.

Q: Where do Shorts still show after I hide the shelf?
A: In the Shorts tab, search results, Subscriptions, channel pages and notifications, which YouTube's help lists as places viewers find Shorts. The X only affects the shelf on Home.

Q: Does the Shorts feed limit remove the Shorts shelf?
A: YouTube's help describes it as a limit for the Shorts feed: at 0 minutes a limit screen appears, and adults can dismiss it. It doesn't say the shelf on Home goes away.


## Can You Turn Off YouTube Shorts? What Works on iPhone (en, checked 2026-10-26)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/can-you-turn-off-youtube-shorts.html · ja https://minulo.app/can-you-turn-off-youtube-shorts.html · ko https://minulo.app/ko/can-you-turn-off-youtube-shorts.html · es https://minulo.app/es/can-you-turn-off-youtube-shorts.html · pt https://minulo.app/pt/can-you-turn-off-youtube-shorts.html · de https://minulo.app/de/can-you-turn-off-youtube-shorts.html · fr https://minulo.app/fr/can-you-turn-off-youtube-shorts.html · it https://minulo.app/it/can-you-turn-off-youtube-shorts.html · id https://minulo.app/id/can-you-turn-off-youtube-shorts.html · th https://minulo.app/th/can-you-turn-off-youtube-shorts.html · vi https://minulo.app/vi/can-you-turn-off-youtube-shorts.html · ru https://minulo.app/ru/can-you-turn-off-youtube-shorts.html · zh-Hant https://minulo.app/zh-Hant/can-you-turn-off-youtube-shorts.html

There's no switch that turns YouTube Shorts off, but minulo hides them for free while normal videos, search and subscriptions keep working. Inside YouTube you can only limit or lower Shorts: set the Shorts feed limit to 0 (adults can dismiss it), choose Show fewer Shorts, tap the X on the Shorts shelf on Home where it appears (news reports say it comes back after 30 days), or turn off watch history to empty Home recommendations. iPhone Screen Time blocks the whole YouTube app, not just Shorts. On a supervised teen account, a parent can set the Shorts timer to zero.

Q: Can you turn off YouTube Shorts?
A: There's no switch in YouTube, but minulo hides Shorts for free while normal videos, search and subscriptions keep working, though only inside minulo. In the YouTube app, the closest options are the Shorts feed limit at 0, which adults can dismiss, and Show fewer Shorts, which lowers Shorts rather than removing them.

Q: Does setting the Shorts feed limit to 0 turn Shorts off?
A: No. At 0 minutes a reminder appears in the Shorts feed, and YouTube's help says you can dismiss or ignore it. It doesn't say Shorts leave Home, search or channel pages.

Q: Can I turn off Shorts but keep normal YouTube videos?
A: Not in the YouTube app itself. Open YouTube in minulo with Hide the Shorts shelf and Hide the Shorts tab turned on; normal videos, subscriptions, Watch later and search keep working. Hiding is free.

Q: Does turning off watch history turn off Shorts?
A: Not as far as YouTube's help says. It removes Home recommendations when you have no relevant recent history, but it doesn't say the Shorts tab or Shorts in search go away, and your history stops being saved.

Q: Can any app turn off Shorts in the official YouTube app?
A: No app can change what the official YouTube app shows; Scroll Less's App Store page says it blocks Shorts inside the real YouTube app by detecting them through an iOS screen broadcast (checked 2026-11-12). minulo can lock the official YouTube app with Screen Time and send you to its Shorts-free view instead. While it is locked, YouTube notifications don't arrive.

Q: Can parents turn off Shorts for a teen?
A: On a supervised teen account, a parent can set the Shorts timer to zero. YouTube announced the Shorts timer for teens in January 2026 and said in April 2026 that the zero option is now live for all parents.


## Use Instagram in Safari Instead of the App? DMs and Reels (en, checked 2026-10-26)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/instagram-in-safari-instead-of-app.html · ja https://minulo.app/instagram-in-safari-instead-of-app.html · ko https://minulo.app/ko/instagram-in-safari-instead-of-app.html · es https://minulo.app/es/instagram-in-safari-instead-of-app.html · pt https://minulo.app/pt/instagram-in-safari-instead-of-app.html · de https://minulo.app/de/instagram-in-safari-instead-of-app.html · fr https://minulo.app/fr/instagram-in-safari-instead-of-app.html · it https://minulo.app/it/instagram-in-safari-instead-of-app.html · id https://minulo.app/id/instagram-in-safari-instead-of-app.html · th https://minulo.app/th/instagram-in-safari-instead-of-app.html · vi https://minulo.app/vi/instagram-in-safari-instead-of-app.html · ru https://minulo.app/ru/instagram-in-safari-instead-of-app.html · zh-Hant https://minulo.app/zh-Hant/instagram-in-safari-instead-of-app.html

If you want Instagram for DMs without Reels, minulo opens Instagram's website with the Reels and Explore tabs and suggested posts hidden for free, and its Every tab but DMs setting leaves only your messages. Deleting the app and using instagram.com in Safari is not the same thing: the website has Reels and Explore too, so they only get a little less handy. To hide them in Safari itself you need a Safari extension such as Nope (free) or ScrollGuard. Without the app you also stop getting Instagram's notifications, and the app is back in a minute if you download it again.

Q: Can I use Instagram for DMs without the app?
A: Yes. minulo opens Instagram's website with Reels, Explore and suggested posts hidden for free, and Every tab but DMs leaves only your messages, though only inside minulo. In plain Safari, instagram.com has DMs too, but the Reels and Explore tabs are still there.

Q: Does instagram.com have Reels?
A: Yes. The website has the Reels and Explore tabs too, which is why apps that open the website, such as minulo, have switches to hide them. In Safari, an extension such as Nope can hide them.

Q: Does deleting the Instagram app delete my account?
A: No. Apple's guide says deleting an app removes it and its data from your iPhone. Your Instagram account and DMs stay, and you can log in again on the website or after downloading the app again.

Q: Will I get DM notifications without the Instagram app?
A: Not from the app, because Instagram's notifications come from the official app. Apple says some websites ask for permission to send notifications; we couldn't confirm whether instagram.com does this on iPhone.

Q: Is there a free Safari extension that hides Instagram Reels?
A: Yes. Nope is free with no subscriptions, in-app purchases or ads, per its App Store page, and hides Reels, Explore and Stories on instagram.com in Safari. It works only in Safari.

Q: Is minulo the same as using Instagram in Safari?
A: It uses the same website, so DMs, posting photos and comments work, and voice messages and calls aren't available. The difference is that minulo hides Reels, Explore and suggested posts, and it can lock the official app so you don't have to delete it.

minulo can lock just the official Instagram app with Screen Time for free, up to 2 hours per block, while LINE stays open, and it hides Reels and keeps DMs if you open Instagram inside it. Downtime works the other way round: Apple says that during downtime only calls, messages and apps you choose to allow are available, so LINE is blocked too unless you allow it. To stop only Instagram, add LINE and any other app you need at night to Always Allowed, keep Instagram off that list, and turn on Block at Downtime. On iOS 27, Screen Time Schedules work by category, and Always Allowed apps stay available regardless.

Q: Can I block only Instagram with Downtime and keep LINE?
A: Yes, and minulo can do it for free too: it locks only the official Instagram app with Screen Time for up to 2 hours per block while LINE stays open. With Downtime, add LINE to Always Allowed, keep Instagram off that list and turn on Block at Downtime.

Q: Why does Downtime block LINE as well?
A: Apple says that during downtime only calls, messages and apps you choose to allow are available. LINE is a separate app, so it is blocked unless you add it to Always Allowed.

Q: Where is Always Allowed on iPhone?
A: Settings, Screen Time, Always Allowed. On iOS 26, add apps under Choose Apps. On iOS 27, tap Add Apps. Apps there stay available during downtime and schedules.

Q: Can App Limits block only Instagram at night?
A: App Limits can target only Instagram, but Apple's steps set an amount of time per day, not a time of night. By default the limit can also be ignored once reached.

Q: Does Downtime block Instagram DMs too?
A: Yes. Downtime works on the whole app, so DMs stop along with Reels. To keep DMs and drop Reels, open Instagram in minulo, which hides Reels for free.

Q: How does this work on iOS 27?
A: Use Screen Time Schedule and choose which Time Allowance categories each time window allows. We couldn't confirm which category LINE and Instagram are in, so add LINE to Always Allowed. All your Apple devices need iOS 27 or later.

## Lock Instagram Automatically at Night on iPhone: What Works (en, checked 2026-10-27)
Source: https://minulo.app/en/lock-apps-automatically-at-night.html · ja https://minulo.app/lock-apps-automatically-at-night.html · ko https://minulo.app/ko/lock-apps-automatically-at-night.html · es https://minulo.app/es/lock-apps-automatically-at-night.html · pt https://minulo.app/pt/lock-apps-automatically-at-night.html · de https://minulo.app/de/lock-apps-automatically-at-night.html · fr https://minulo.app/fr/lock-apps-automatically-at-night.html · it https://minulo.app/it/lock-apps-automatically-at-night.html · id https://minulo.app/id/lock-apps-automatically-at-night.html · th https://minulo.app/th/lock-apps-automatically-at-night.html · vi https://minulo.app/vi/lock-apps-automatically-at-night.html · ru https://minulo.app/ru/lock-apps-automatically-at-night.html · zh-Hant https://minulo.app/zh-Hant/lock-apps-automatically-at-night.html

minulo can lock the official Instagram, TikTok or YouTube app with Screen Time for free, up to 2 hours per block, and with minulo Pro, Sleep mode starts the block by itself every night at your bedtime and ends it at your wake time (one time, the same every day). Among iPhone's own settings, Downtime with Block at Downtime is the one that stops apps at set times. Apple describes Sleep Focus as filtering notifications and calls, Require Face ID only asks for your own face or passcode, and in Apple's Shortcuts guide we couldn't find an action that closes or blocks another app. So Sleep Focus or a Shortcuts automation alone won't keep Reels closed at night.

Q: Can I make Instagram lock automatically at night on iPhone?
A: Yes: minulo locks the official Instagram app with Screen Time for free, up to 2 hours per block, and minulo Pro's Sleep mode starts the block every night at your bedtime and ends it at your wake time. Built in, Downtime with Block at Downtime stops every app that is not Always Allowed at the times you set.

Q: Does Sleep Focus block apps?
A: Apple describes Sleep Focus as filtering notifications and calls and showing that you're unavailable. Its guide doesn't say a Focus stops an app from opening. You can switch to a Home Screen page without Instagram while it's on.

Q: Can a Shortcuts automation close or lock an app at a set time?
A: Automations can run at a time of day, but we couldn't find an action in Apple's Shortcuts guide that closes, locks or blocks another app. Use Downtime or a blocker app for the lock.

Q: Does Require Face ID stop me from opening Instagram at night?
A: No. It asks for Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode each time you open the app, so you can still open it yourself, and it is not tied to a time of night.

Q: Can I lock Instagram at night and keep my messaging apps?
A: Yes. With Downtime, add the messaging apps to Always Allowed and leave Instagram out. minulo locks only the apps you choose and leaves the rest open.

Q: Is there a free way to lock apps automatically every night?
A: Downtime is free and built in. minulo's locks are free for up to 2 hours per block that you start, but locking every night by itself (Sleep mode) needs minulo Pro.

minulo hides the Shorts shelf and Shorts tab for free and sends Shorts links to the normal player, so a Short you tap in Subscriptions or search doesn't pull you into the swipe feed. YouTube's own help lists where viewers find Shorts: the Shorts tab, search results, the homepage, channel pages, Subscriptions and notifications. Q: Why do Shorts still show in Subscriptions after I set the Shorts limit to 0?

Q: Does minulo remove every Short from Subscriptions and search?

Q: Do these settings work in the official YouTube app?

minulo can lock the official Instagram, TikTok or YouTube app with Screen Time for free, up to 2 hours per block, which covers an hour of study or a few 25-minute focus rounds. iPhone's own Screen Time has no button that blocks an app for exactly one hour: App Limits count your use across the day, and Downtime turned on by hand runs until tomorrow. A Downtime schedule can block a set window, but you choose the times in advance in Settings. minulo has no Pomodoro timer of its own, so pair it with any timer you like.

Q: Can I block Instagram for just one hour on iPhone?
A: Yes, with minulo, which locks the official Instagram app with Screen Time for free, up to 2 hours per block. iPhone's own Screen Time has no one-hour button: App Limits count daily use, and Downtime turned on by hand lasts until tomorrow.

Q: Can I set Screen Time to block an app for 25 minutes?
A: Not as a one-off timer. App Limits set a daily amount, and Downtime runs on a schedule or until tomorrow. You can schedule a Downtime window for your study time, but you set it in advance in Settings.

Q: Is there a Pomodoro app that blocks Instagram?
A: Several focus timer apps say they block apps during a session. We haven't tested them, so check their App Store pages. minulo has no timer of its own, but its free block keeps the official apps locked for up to 2 hours, which covers a few 25-minute rounds.

Q: What if I really need the app during the block?

Q: Can the block start by itself every day?
A: With Downtime, yes, on the schedule you set. In minulo, Pro's Sleep mode starts a block by itself every night, with one bedtime and wake time that are the same every day. On the free plan you start each block yourself.
